entities.name: Gerrard Capashen
entities.description: The heir to the Legacy and a master-at-arms in Benalia who returns to the Weatherlight to rescue Sisay and fight Volrath.

entities.name: Sisay
entities.description: The captain of the flying ship Weatherlight, kidnapped by Volrath.

entities.name: Volrath
entities.description: The ruler of the plane of Rath, formerly Vuel, Gerrard's adoptive brother, who steals the Legacy and plans Dominaria's invasion.

entities.name: Karn
entities.description: A silver golem bound by an oath to protect Gerrard, who has taken a vow of pacifism and is tortured in the Stronghold.

entities.name: Tahngarth
entities.description: A minotaur first mate of the Weatherlight who is captured and tortured by Volrath.

entities.name: Hanna
entities.description: A Tolarian artificer and navigator of the Weatherlight, Barrin's daughter and Gerrard's beloved.

entities.name: Orim
entities.description: The Samite healer of the Weatherlight who loves Crovax.

entities.name: Crovax
entities.description: A nobleman of Urborg who joins the Weatherlight to find Selenia, kills her, and is transformed into a vampire.

entities.name: Squee
entities.description: A goblin cabin hand of the Weatherlight.

entities.name: Mirri
entities.description: A cat warrior and Gerrard's friend, who is in love with him and is left behind in Volrath's Gardens.

entities.name: Rofellos
entities.description: An elf friend of Gerrard slain by Gallowbraid.

entities.name: Multani
entities.description: The Maro-Sorcerer under whom Gerrard learns magic.

entities.name: Starke il-Vec
entities.description: A Phyrexian-bound schemer who corrupted Vuel and betrays Sisay to Volrath to free his daughter.

entities.name: Sidar Kondo
entities.description: The sidar who raised Gerrard and Vuel and is murdered by Vuel.

entities.name: Selenia
entities.description: A guardian angel bound to Crovax who attacks him on Rath and is killed by him.

entities.name: Ilcaster
entities.description: A young boy who listens to the Master's retelling in a library at night.

entities.name: The Master
entities.description: An old wizard in a library who recounts Gerrard's story to Ilcaster.

entities.name: Ertai
entities.description: A young Tolarian wizard who joins the Weatherlight crew and is left behind on Rath.

entities.name: Barrin
entities.description: A Tolarian wizard, Hanna's father and Ertai's teacher.

entities.name: Greven il-Vec
entities.description: The commander of the Predator who fights Gerrard.

entities.name: Vhati il-Dal
entities.description: Greven's first mate who plans mutiny and is thrown off the Predator.

entities.name: Eladamri
entities.description: The elf leader who leads the attack on the Stronghold.

entities.name: The Oracle en-Vec
entities.description: An en-Vec oracle who meets Gerrard and calls him the Korvecdal.

entities.name: Lyna
entities.description: A Soltari emissary who strikes a bargain with Ertai to pass through the portal.

entities.name: Maraxus
entities.description: A warlord sent by Volrath to hold Starke captive, stabbed in the back by Starke.

entities.name: Takara en-Dal
entities.description: Starke's daughter, imprisoned by Volrath.

entities.name: Javero
entities.description: A young Benalish trainee killed by Torsten.

entities.name: Torsten
entities.description: A Benalish trainee who joins the assassins' guild and attacks Gerrard.

entities.name: Lord Kastan
entities.description: An albino recruiting Benalish trainees for an assassins' guild.

entities.name: Alaric
entities.description: A Benalish commander who betrays Gerrard and kills himself with poisoned wine.

entities.name: Keilic
entities.description: A Chitr'ini cat warrior who courts Mirri and is killed by the Spirit Way.

entities.name: Gallowbraid
entities.description: A horror that attacks Crovax's estate and slays Rofellos.

entities.name: Spirit Way
entities.description: A black cat spirit beast met in Mirri's spirit walk that prophesies her fate.

entities.name: Aboroth
entities.description: A monster at Llanowar that Gerrard turns to metal pieces with the Thran Forge.

entities.name: Slivers
entities.description: Creatures of the Furnace of Rath that attack the Weatherlight.

entities.name: Rath
entities.description: The artificial plane ruled by Volrath.

entities.name: Dominaria
entities.description: The plane threatened by Volrath's invasion plans.

entities.name: Benalia
entities.description: The nation where Gerrard is a master-at-arms.

entities.name: Tolaria
entities.description: The island of Barrin, hard to find on any map.

entities.name: Llanowar
entities.description: A forest where Mirri lives and the crew fights an aboroth.

entities.name: Urborg
entities.description: The land of Crovax's estate.

entities.name: Skyshroud
entities.description: The forest where the Weatherlight crashes.

entities.name: The Stronghold
entities.description: Volrath's fortress on Rath.

entities.name: Furnace of Rath
entities.description: A fiery region of Rath that the Weatherlight crosses.

entities.name: Death Pits of Rath
entities.description: Where Volrath places his failed experiments.

entities.name: Dream Halls
entities.description: A tower in the Stronghold where Gerrard confronts Volrath.

entities.name: Volrath's Gardens
entities.description: Gardens near the Stronghold where Mirri is left behind.

entities.name: Weatherlight
entities.description: The flying ship that is part of the Legacy and can shift between planes.

entities.name: Legacy
entities.description: A collection of powerful magical artifacts that is Dominaria's defense.

entities.name: Touchstone
entities.description: An artifact Vuel uses to deactivate Karn.

entities.name: Thran Tome
entities.description: A book from which Sisay and Gerrard learn about the Weatherlight and a counter-spell.

entities.name: Thran crystal
entities.description: The crystal responsible for planeshifting the Weatherlight to Rath.

entities.name: Skyshaper
entities.description: A Legacy artifact Karn fits into the Weatherlight.

entities.name: Thran Forge
entities.description: A Legacy artifact Gerrard uses to turn the aboroth to metal.

entities.name: Null Rod
entities.description: An artifact in Gerrard's office that does nothing but look flashy.

entities.name: The Predator
entities.description: A flying ship commanded by Greven il-Vec.

entities.name: Soltari
entities.description: A people pulled through a planar portal who wage war on the Field of Souls.

entities.name: Phyrexians
entities.description: Beings who guard Volrath's Stronghold and stand behind Starke's masters.

entities.name: Weatherlight crew
entities.description: The crew of the Weatherlight.

entities.name: Tolarian Temporal Disaster
entities.description: The disaster that destroyed the Tolarian Academy, alluded to by the Master.

events.summary: Ilcaster surprises an old master in a library at night.
events.quote: A young boy named Ilcaster surprises an old wizard, known simply as a master, in a library at night.

events.summary: Starke convinces Vuel that Gerrard intends to steal his birthright.
events.quote: Starke il-Vec arrived and convinced the arrogant Vuel that Gerrard intended to steal his birthright

events.summary: Vuel steals the Legacy and deactivates Karn with the Touchstone.
events.quote: deactivating him with the Touchstone while he was distracted

events.summary: Sisay recruits Gerrard and his friends as Weatherlight crew after a knife-throwing contest.
events.quote: recruited the companions as crew on the Weatherlight as payment for a bet

events.summary: Gallowbraid slays Rofellos and Crovax summons Selenia.
events.quote: When Rofellos was slain by Gallowbraid, Crovax used his cursed heirloom to summon the guardian angel Selenia

events.summary: Gerrard and Mirri leave the Weatherlight crew, blaming the Legacy for Rofellos's death.
events.quote: Gerrard, with Mirri in tow, left the crew of the Weatherlight

events.summary: Starke betrays Sisay to Volrath to lure Gerrard to Rath and free his daughter.
events.quote: he betrayed Sisay to Volrath and then begged the remaining crew to find Gerrard and rescue him

events.summary: Gerrard breaks up a fight in the Benalish training yard by shooting Torsten.
events.quote: Gerrard breaks up the fight by threatening and ultimately shooting Torsten in the leg with a longbow.

events.summary: Torsten dies after attacking Gerrard with a poisoned dagger and the Null Rod.
events.quote: Torsten makes a last-ditch attempt to kill Gerrard but uses the Null Rod, remembering it from the demonstration on his first day.

events.summary: Alaric kills himself with the poisoned wine at Gerrard's suggestion.
events.quote: Alaric, at his former friend Gerrard's suggestion, decides to kill himself with the wine to save his reputation.

events.summary: Gerrard rejoins the Weatherlight and appoints Tahngarth first mate.
events.quote: Gerrard is introduced to old and new crewmates and appoints Tahngarth as the first mate

events.summary: Karn takes his vow of pacifism.
events.quote: Karn then took his vow of pacifism, even at his own and Gerrard's expense.

events.summary: An aboroth chases the Weatherlight until elvish war machines stop it.
events.quote: The monster pursues the Weatherlight, almost catching its sails when it is stopped by elvish war machines.

events.summary: Gerrard defeats the aboroth with the Thran Forge and the Touchstone.
events.quote: Gerrard turned the aboroth into metal pieces with the Thran forge and then deactivated it with the Touchstone

events.summary: Tahngarth admits that the Weatherlight needs Gerrard.
events.quote: Tahngarth begrudgingly admits to Orim that the Weatherlight needs Gerrard

events.summary: Ertai agrees to join the Weatherlight crew.
events.quote: Ertai agrees to join the crew

events.summary: Ertai defeats a fog elemental with the Chimeric Sphere.
events.quote: attacks from the mists surrounding the hill, which Ertai defeats by piloting the Chimeric Sphere with a Mind Stone

events.summary: Starke stabs Maraxus in the back after Maraxus fights Gerrard.
events.quote: Maraxus, fearful of Volrath's punishment for losing Starke, battled Gerrard but was stabbed in the back by Starke.

events.summary: The Predator ambushes the Weatherlight under Greven's command.
events.quote: they were ambushed by the Predator , under the command of Greven il- Vec.

events.summary: Greven throws Vhati off the Predator for treachery.
events.quote: he is thrown off the side of the Predator

events.summary: Gerrard is knocked overboard in his duel with Greven.
events.quote: another mogg shot makes the ship lurch, sending Gerrard over the side and denying Greven his victory.

events.summary: Tahngarth stows away on the Predator.
events.quote: Tahngarth grabbed a rope and stowed away on the Predator as it flew away.

events.summary: The Weatherlight crashes in the Skyshroud forest.
events.quote: The Weatherlight, meanwhile, crashed in the Shyshroud forest.

events.summary: The moggs break the Thran crystal, stranding the crew on Rath.
events.quote: the moggs broke the Thran crystal during their attack, stranding them on Rath

events.summary: Hanna kills a shapeshifter in the Skyshroud forest.
events.quote: She disarms the monster and slices it open

events.summary: Eladamri decides the elves will attack the Stronghold.
events.quote: Eladamri decides that the time has come for the elves to attack the Stronghold

events.summary: Gerrard and Hanna share a long kiss.
events.quote: Gerrard and Hanna share a long kiss

events.summary: Starke recalls his mission to groom Vuel as evincar of Rath.
events.quote: Starke recalls his mission to groom Vuel into a man fit to be evincar of Rath twelve years prior.

events.summary: Gerrard saves Vuel on the cliff, ruining his rite of passage.
events.quote: Starke saw Gerrard, having scaled the cliff somehow, save Vuel from falling to his death, and ruining his rite of passage

events.summary: Starke gives Vuel the Touchstone and urges revenge.
events.quote: giving Vuel the Touchstone

events.summary: Vuel murders Sidar Kondo.
events.quote: finally confronted and murdered Sidar Kondo

events.summary: Slivers burst into the Weatherlight in the Furnace of Rath.
events.quote: the slivers burst through the walls of the cave to attack the Weatherlight

events.summary: Volrath enslaves Starke as chamberlain and imprisons Takara.
events.quote: Volrath found Takara and imprisoned her in his dungeons

events.summary: Lyna and Ertai strike a bargain over the portal.
events.quote: she would help him open the portal, and in return, he would allow her and her people to pass through it

events.summary: Hanna saves the ship from burning with an improvised lightning rod.
events.quote: Hanna made an improvised lightning rod from a piece of railing and saved the ship from burning.

events.summary: Skeletons board the ship in the Death Pits until Squee's Salvation Sphere repels them.
events.quote: which repelled the skeletons

events.summary: Mirri kills a guard as the crew docks at the Stronghold.
events.quote: Mirri slew a guard who had noticed them before he had time to scream.

events.summary: Gerrard sees the map of Volrath's invasion plans for Dominaria.
events.quote: Gerrard realizes that it represents Volrath's Invasion Plans

events.summary: Karn surrenders to the Predator after accidentally killing a mogg.
events.quote: after surrendering to the Predator once he accidentally killed a mogg during the ambush

events.summary: Karn kills a village boy in anger at Albiuto, in flashback.
events.quote: Karn furiously uppercut a food wagon, and a young village boy was crushed when it landed.

events.summary: Karn takes up his vow of pacifism over the blacksmith's shrine, in flashback.
events.quote: Over it, Karn took his vow of pacifism.

events.summary: Karn is reactivated by Gerrard, in flashback.
events.quote: Sometime later, he felt joy again as Gerrard reactivated him

events.summary: Karn refuses to kill his torturers in the Stronghold.
events.quote: Karn resolves to remain to stand and not kill any of his torturers

events.summary: The rescue party frees Karn and Tahngarth but finds only a shapeshifter in place of Sisay.
events.quote: It turned out to be a shapeshifter, however

events.summary: Selenia wounds Mirri on the bridge to the Dream Halls.
events.quote: The angel turns her attack toward the cat warrior, slicing her deep across the belly.

events.summary: Crovax runs Selenia through with his sword.
events.quote: Crovax runs her through with his sword

events.summary: Selenia's shards stream into Crovax and Tahngarth saves him from jumping.
events.quote: Selenia shatters into countless shards that stream into Crovax's body through his face.

events.summary: Crovax is transformed by his angel's death.
events.quote: having been transformed by his guardian angel's death

events.summary: Tahngarth returns mutilated, carrying the wounded Mirri and Crovax.
events.quote: Tahngarth reappears, emerging from the Stronghold mutilated by Volrath's tortures and carrying the wounded Mirri and Crovax.

events.summary: Karn returns with the Legacy pieces and the Skyshaper.
events.quote: Karn returns with the missing pieces of the Legacy as well as the Skyshaper

events.summary: Hanna drags the Predator into the Stronghold.
events.quote: Hanna orders the steersman to speed up, dragging the Predator behind them and causing it to crash into the Stronghold.

events.summary: Hanna fires a beam from the steering wheel at the ornithopters.
events.quote: She then causes a beam of light to fire from the steering wheel

events.summary: Tahngarth commandeers an ornithopter to try to pick up Gerrard.
events.quote: the minotaur jumps aboard the ornithopter and takes control of it

events.summary: Gerrard and Tahngarth kill Volrath, whose body shapeshifts.
events.quote: The two killed Volrath, but the body shapeshifted into one of Volrath's experiments.

events.summary: Crovax ambushes Mirri in the lower deck of the Weatherlight.
events.quote: Mirri is ambushed from behind somewhere in the lower deck by her former ally, who says it is his destiny for him to kill her.

events.summary: Mirri takes Crovax overboard with her into the Gardens.
events.quote: she is dropped overboard by Crovax, but grabs his wrist and takes him down with her

events.summary: Keilic allows the Spirit Way to rip out his throat after Mirri's choice, in flashback.
events.quote: Keilic accepted Mirri's choice and allowed his throat to be ripped out by the beast.

events.summary: Crovax bites Mirri's neck.
events.quote: He wrests free and tells her that she will join him to rule Rath, before biting into her neck.

events.summary: Gerrard leaves Mirri behind to die.
events.quote: departs with the ship, leaving the cat warrior behind to die

events.summary: The Weatherlight leaves Ertai behind on Rath.
events.quote: they were forced to leave Ertai behind on Rath

events.summary: The Predator slams into the closing portal and Ertai falls at Greven's feet.
events.quote: the Predator slammed into it, causing Ertai to fall into the wreckage at the feet of the furious Greven il- Vec
